newsitem.title: USA: ComEd sees Dresden 3 nuke restart Jan. 13.
newsitem.headline: ComEd sees Dresden 3 nuke restart Jan. 13.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 794 megawatt (MW) Dresden 3 nuclear power unit in Morris, Illinois, will likely restart January 13, a company spokesman said Monday.
The unit was shut October 26 for maintenance.

The adjacent Dresden unit 2, with an identical generating capacity, has been operating at about 40 percent power for about a week. Repairs to the unit's turbine control valve may be completed by Tuesday, he said, which will allow the unit to begin power ascension.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
